title: My dogs love it
text: I have three German Shepherds. I’ve subscribed to the large Gnaw Box for several months now. My dogs love the treats. They are all appropriate for larger sized dogs. Each box contains a different variety of treats. None of them lasts very long for such strong chewers, but the dogs enjoy them for a few minutes at least.  Occasionally there are treats that take them longer to chew. I’ve been satisfied with the quality of the products and have felt safe giving them to my dogs. The ears, tracheas, bully sticks, and rings have all been large enough for my dogs that I didn’t worry about them just swallowing them without chewing first.
label: positive
